## load data
```{r}
data<-read_excel("sample_knn_dataset.xlsx")
head(data)
cat("No of rows",nrow(data),"\n")
cat("No of columns",ncol(data))
```
 
 
 
## introduction to k nearest neighbour (knn)
- knn is a simple and popular supervised machine learning algorithm used for
** classification** problems
** regression ** problems
- it works by finding the nearest data points to a new observation and making prediction based on those neighbours


## check data structure
```{r}
str(data)
```

## check for missing values
```{r}
colSums(is.na(data))
```
## view summary
```{r}
describe(data)
summary(data)
```

## convert target variables intyo factor 
```{r}
data$Loan_Approved<-factor(data$Loan_Approved)
summary(data)
```

## check levels for target variable
```{r}
levels(data$Loan_Approved)
```

## split data into training and test
```{r}
set.seed(123)
splitted_index<-createDataPartition(data$Loan_Approved, p=.8, list=FALSE)
train<-data[splitted_index, ]
test<-data[-splitted_index, ]
# check dimensions 
dim(train)
dim(test)
```

## normalize numerical variables
```{r}
normalize<-function(x){
  return((x-min(x))/ (max(x)-min(x)))
}
```

## select predictor- normalize-target variables
```{r}
train_x<-train[, 1:4]
test_x<-test[, 1:4]
# normalize predictors
train_x<-as.data.frame(lapply(train_x, normalize))
test_x<-as.data.frame(lapply(test_x, normalize))
 # target variables
train_y<-train$Loan_Approved
test_y<-test$Loan_Approved
# view normalized data
head(train_x)
```



## build knn model
### k= number of neighbours
### commonm values: 3, 5, 7,9
```{r}
knn_model<-knn(
  train=train_x,
  test=test_x,
  cl=train_y,
  k=5
)

```

## predictions
```{r}
predictions<-knn_model
head(predictions)
```
 
# check test_y head
```{r}
head(test_y)
```



## confusion matrix
```{r}
confusionMatrix(predictions, test_y)
```



# test difference k values
```{r}
k_value<-c(3:20)
for(k in k_value){
  model<-knn(
    train=train_x,
    test=test_x,
    cl= train_y,
    k=k
  )
  acc<-sum(model==test_y)/length(test_y)
  print(paste(
    "k=",k,
    "accuracy=",
    round(acc*100, 2),"%" ))
}
```


# predict new observationj
```{r}
New_customer<- data.frame(

)
head(New_customer)
```

predictions<-knn_model
predictions

# KNN regression
## import excel dataset
```{r}
head(data)
```

 # predict loan amount
 spit data into test and train
```{r}
 set.seed(123)
split_loan<-createDataPartition(data$Loan_Amount, p=.9, list=FALSE)
train<-data[split_loan, ]
test<-data[-split_loan, ]
```
## feature selection
```{r}
train_x= train[, c("Age", "Income", "Credit_Score")]
test_x= test[, c("Age", "Income", "Credit_Score")]
```


# target variables
```{r}
train_y<-train$Loan_Amount
test_y=test$Loan_Amount
```

# data scaling/normalization
```{r}
preProcess_model<-preProcess(
  train_x,
  method=c("center", "scale")
)
```
 
# apply scaling
```{r}
train_x_scaled<-predict(preProcess_model, train_x)
test_x_scaled<-predict(preProcess_model, test_x)
```

# view scaled data
```{r}
head(train_x_scaled)
```


## Build knn regression model
```{r}
knn_reg_model<-knn.reg(
  train=train_x_scaled,
  test=test_x_scaled,
  y= train_y,
  k=15
)
```

# model predictions
```{r}
prediction<- knn_reg_model
prediction

```
```{r}
head(test_y)
```
 
# model evaluation
```{r}
rmse_val= rmse(test_y, prediction)
mae_val=mae(test_y, prediction)
mse_val=mse(test_y, prediction)
r_sqr=cor(test_y, prediction)

# print parametrics

cat("RMSE:",round(rmse_val, 2))
cat("MSE:",round(mse_val, 2))
cat("maE:",round(mae_val, 2))
cat("r sqred:",round(r_sqr, 2))
```
 
# actual vs predicted
```{r}
 result1<-data.frame(
   Actual= Test_y,
   predicted=prediction
 )
head(result1)
```
 # new data application
```{r}
new_data=data.frame(
  Age=35,
  Income= 35000,
  credit_Score= 700
)
```
# apply sam scaling
```{r}
new_data_scale<- predict(
preProcess_model,
new_data
)
```
# predict loan amount
```{r}
new_prediction<- knn.reg(
train=train_x_scaled,
test=new_data_scale,
y=train_y,
k=15
)
# display prediction
print(paste("predicted loan Amount:", round(new_prediction$pred, 2)))
```
